decision: Two pale wooden shipping crates on one pallet, supplied as a 296,178-triangle TRELLIS GLB. The 9,000-triangle trial damaged slats and top detail. A 17,800-triangle reduction retains the silhouette and readable wood, split into two pieces under Roblox's 10,000-triangle per-mesh limit. A newly modeled off-white plastic film covers the full length of both boxes, including top, sides, and both ends; only the pallet feet remain exposed. Provisional 8-stud-long, static decoration.
